Capture a File-Hash Manifest of a Submission

Source: R/repro_manifest.R
repro_manifest.Rd

Records an integrity manifest of every file in a submission's analysis code folder: its path (relative to the folder, with forward slashes), size in bytes, and MD5 hash. The manifest lets a reviewer confirm that the files they received are byte-for-byte the files the sponsor hashed, and lets a reproduction run confirm that nothing in the folder changed. Hashing uses tools::md5sum(), the same mechanism the output-reproduction check (assess_output_reproduction()) already uses, so the manifest is deterministic and needs no network access.

Usage

repro_manifest(path, file = NULL, exclude = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to the submission's analysis code folder.

file

Optional path to write the manifest to as JSON. When supplied, the manifest is written there and the path is returned invisibly; otherwise the manifest tibble is returned.

exclude

Optional character vector of regular expressions matched against each file's relative path. Any file whose path matches is left out of the manifest (for example "\\.log$" to skip run logs).

Value

A tibble with one row per file and the columns file (relative path, forward slashes), bytes (size, numeric), algo (the hash algorithm, "md5"), and hash (the lowercase MD5 digest). When file is supplied, the path to the written JSON manifest is returned invisibly instead. The JSON document carries a manifest_type, a schema_version, the generation time, the algorithm, the source package and version, the folder name, the file count, and a files array.

Details

This is an integrity helper, not an indicator. It emits no R4SUB evidence, carries no severity, and does not change the pass/fail or score of any indicator. Verify a folder against a manifest with repro_manifest_verify().

See also

repro_manifest_verify() to check a folder against a manifest.

Examples

d <- file.path(tempdir(), "sub_manifest")
dir.create(file.path(d, "data"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines("source('a.R')", file.path(d, "run.R"))
writeLines("x <- read.csv('data/adsl.csv')", file.path(d, "a.R"))
writeLines("usubjid,age\n01,55", file.path(d, "data", "adsl.csv"))

# As a tibble
repro_manifest(d)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>   file          bytes algo  hash                            
#>   <chr>         <dbl> <chr> <chr>                           
#> 1 a.R              31 md5   629d9c62abc37a13b6627e297ecfa89a
#> 2 data/adsl.csv    18 md5   929c31d1525ecfb112d9cbc10788ed64
#> 3 run.R            14 md5   0b2b1f27969de6de065a65a25dd109f5

# Written to a JSON file
mf <- repro_manifest(d, file = file.path(d, "manifest.json"))
#> ✔ Wrote file manifest (3 files) to /tmp/RtmpXgcl4F/sub_manifest/manifest.json
file.exists(mf)
#> [1] TRUE
